title: EvoAl memory model: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the files of the memory model writer.

formatVersion.description: EvoAl release that defines this file format. Changes with a release only if the format changes incompatibly.

featureName.description: Name of a data description (DDL), e.g. 'x:0'.

individualId.description: Identifier of an individual, unique within a run. Every run starts at 0.

nonFiniteNumber.description: A number that JSON cannot represent: not a number, positive or negative infinity. Written as a string.

number.description: A number, or a non-finite number written as a string.

value.description: Value of a feature. Arrays are nested JSON arrays; enum literals are written by name; null if the feature is unset. Non-finite numbers of real features are written as the strings 'NaN', 'Infinity' and '-Infinity' (see nonFiniteNumber).

values.description: Values of a space, keyed by feature name.

feature.description: A feature (variable) of the search or optimisation space.

scale.description: Scale of the data description, if declared.

relationship.description: Origin of an individual. In the final version, the targets are individuals of the previous iteration (or of earlier ones); in the steps version, the direct predecessors, which may be individuals of the same iteration, e.g. the recombined child of a mutated one.

partner.description: Recombination only: the sibling, i.e. the individual that was created by the same recombination (holder of the 'other' relationship). Missing if the sibling is not recorded, e.g. because it did not survive the replacement.

properties.description: Further details of the relationship, e.g. the reason of a replacement. Defined in 'propertyDefinitions' of execution-information.json with the scope 'relationship'. Missing if there are none.

output.description: The objectives. Empty if the individual is not evaluated, e.g. a candidate created before the evaluation budget ran out (only in the steps version).

fitness.description: The fitness computed from the output, one value per component, in the order of 'fitness.components' of execution-information.json. Smaller values are better. Empty if the individual is not evaluated.

properties.description: Further details of the individual. Defined in 'propertyDefinitions' of execution-information.json with the scope 'individual'. Missing if there are none.

configuration.description: An instance of a DL type, e.g., a target distance or a fitness step: its fully qualified type and its attribute values (with defaults applied). Nested instances are configurations, data is written by name.

propertyName.description: Name of a property, unique within its scope, e.g. 'reason'.

propertyValue.description: A single property value: an integer, a real number, a text or a truth value.

properties.description: Values of properties, keyed by property name. A value is a single value or a list of values, as given by its definition.

propertyDefinition.description: Defines a property of the individuals or relationships of the run (PropertyDefinition). Every key of a 'properties' object is defined with the matching scope.

scope.description: 'individual': recorded on individuals; 'relationship': recorded on relationships.

valueType.description: 'integer' values are JSON integers, 'real' values JSON numbers, 'text' values strings and 'boolean' values true or false.

list.description: Whether a value is a list of values of the value type.

metricName.description: Name of a metric, unique within a run, e.g. 'evaluations.real'.

metricDefinition.description: Defines a metric of the run (MetricDefinition). Every key of a 'metrics' object is defined with the matching scope.

kind.description: 'counter': the value never decreases (e.g. the number of evaluations); 'measure': the value can change arbitrarily.

valueType.description: 'integer' values are JSON integers, 'real' values are JSON numbers.

scope.description: 'execution': recorded once for the run (execution-finished.json); 'iteration': recorded in every iteration (iteration-<number>.json).

metrics.description: Values of metrics, keyed by metric name.

rank.description: Individuals of equal fitness. Rank 0 is the best.
